verdict.rationale: Twenty offers a developer-first REST/GraphQL API with auto-generated per-workspace docs, an interactive playground, a Metadata API, and a CLI (`create-twenty-app`, `twenty app:publish`) for scaffolding apps in React/TypeScript — enough for AI-native developers to build against Twenty programmatically. However, there is no explicit mention of a distributed 'official SDK' package (e.g., a published client library like @twenty/sdk in Python/JS) beyond the API and CLI tooling. Missing for 10: a named official SDK/client library, multi-language SDK support, and independent hands-on confirmation that these APIs/CLI work reliably as an SDK-equivalent for AI agents.
